# Appeal of Denial — Total Shoulder Arthroplasty (CPT 23472)

**Emerson Lawson**
Member ID: W445912797
[Street address]
[City, State, ZIP]
[Phone] | [Email]

**Date:** [Date of this letter]

Providence Health Plan
Appeals and Grievance Department
P.O. Box 4158
Portland, OR 97208-4158

**RE: Appeal of adverse benefit determination dated 2026-08-02 — Reference number POC-5717F9EEEF-88905**
**Member:** Emerson Lawson | **Member ID:** W445912797 | **Plan:** Providence Health Plan (Commercial/ACA), Oregon
**Service denied:** Total shoulder replacement, CPT 23472
**Governing policy:** *Total Shoulder Arthroplasty MP430* — https://www.providencehealthplan.com/-/media/providence/website/pdfs/providers/medical-policy-and-provider-information/medical-policies/mp430.pdf

---

## What I am asking for

I am appealing the denial of my prior authorization for a total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472), issued on 2026-08-02 under reference number POC-5717F9EEEF-88905. The notice states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am asking the plan to reconsider that decision, because the records already in the file address the criteria set out in the plan's own policy, *Total Shoulder Arthroplasty MP430*. My surgeon, Dr. Duval, MD, orthopedic surgery, has documented that this procedure is needed.

If any specific document is missing from my file, I am glad to have it sent. But before I can do that, I need to know what the plan found to be missing, and which criteria it applied. The notice does not say.

## The plan's own criteria, and what my records show

The plan's policy lists the coverage requirements for this procedure. I have quoted the plan's language below exactly as it appears in the policy. Several of the excerpts end in a colon and introduce lists of further conditions that were not reproduced in the material available to me; I am not guessing at what those lists contain, and I ask the plan to identify the specific subsections it applied.

**1. Coverage framework**

> "o Total shoulder arthroplasty (CPT 23472) when all the following criteria are met:"

**2. No active infection**

> "A. There is no active infection in the shoulder joint; and"

My records state: **no active infection.** The clinical summary in the prior authorization packet documents no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, non-smoker.

**3. Pain criteria**

> "B. At least two of the following are met (1.-3.) 1. Pain interferes with activities of daily living (ADLs); or 2. Pain is increased with initiation of activity; or 3. Pain occurs with range of motion (ROM); and"

My records state: I have had **9 months of progressive pain in the shoulder, unrelieved by rest.** On function, the records document that I **cannot reach overhead, dress without help, or sleep on the affected side.** Those are activities of daily living, and the records show my pain interferes with them. If the plan requires additional charting specific to items 2 and 3, my surgeon's office can supply the examination note at [date of most recent office visit], and I ask that the plan tell me that rather than closing the file as incomplete.

**4. Range of motion or crepitus**

> "6. Osteoarthritis or post-traumatic arthritis and the following criteria are met (a.-b.): a. Member has either limited range of motion or crepitus with glenohumeral joint rotation; and"

My records state **both** findings this criterion accepts in the alternative. On examination: **glenohumeral crepitus; active forward elevation limited to 90 degrees and external rotation to 10 degrees; cuff strength intact.** My diagnosis as recorded by my surgeon is [diagnosis exactly as stated in the clinic note].

**5. Imaging findings**

> "b. Either of the following are met: i. Imaging shows bone-on-bone contact; or ii. Member has continued symptoms despite conservative treatments within the last year and at least two of the following are present (i.- vii.): a. Subchondral cysts; or b. Subchondral sclerosis; or c. Periarticular osteophytes; or d. Joint subluxation; or e. Joint space narrowing; or f. Bony glenoid deformity; or g. Other structural pathology;"

My records state, from shoulder radiographs (true AP and axillary) dated **2026-05-21**: **complete loss of glenohumeral joint space with osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis and a flattened glenoid.** A **CT confirms an intact rotator cuff.**

This satisfies the first branch of the criterion, and it independently satisfies the second: my symptoms have continued despite conservative treatment within the last year (described below), and the imaging documents more than two of the listed findings — osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis, loss of joint space, and a flattened glenoid.

**6. Conservative care documentation**

> "• Clinical documentation of extent and response to conservative care, as applicable to the policy criteria, including outcomes of any procedural interventions, medication use and physical therapy notes"

My records state:
- **Supervised physical therapy** focused on range of motion and periscapular strengthening, **8 weeks, 2026-04-11 to 2026-06-06, 20 visits completed**, documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- **NSAIDs for 6 months** with inadequate relief.
- **Corticosteroid injection on 2026-03-22**, giving **4 weeks of partial relief** — the outcome of a procedural intervention, as the policy asks for.

Each of these is a category the policy names: medication use, physical therapy notes, and the outcome of a procedural intervention. The policy excerpt available to me does not state a required number of weeks or visits for non-rheumatoid conservative care, and I am not assuming one. If the plan applied a duration threshold, I ask it to state the threshold and where it appears in the policy.

**7. Functional impairment documentation**

> "• Evaluation and documentation of the extent and specifics of one or more of the functional impairments or disabilities (see Policy Guidelines)"

My records state the specifics: I **cannot reach overhead, dress without help, or sleep on the affected side**, with **active forward elevation limited to 90 degrees and external rotation to 10 degrees.** This excerpt refers to Policy Guidelines that were not reproduced in the material available to me; I ask the plan to identify what those Guidelines require if it considers this element unmet.

**8. Imaging requirements**

> "• Imaging requirements: o Imaging completed within the past 12 months o Documented interpretation of x-rays, which may be performed and read by the operating surgeon. o If advanced imaging is required, a radiologist's report (for CT, MRI, US or bone scan)."

My imaging was completed on **2026-05-21**, within 12 months of the request and of this appeal. Interpretation of the radiographs is documented, and the policy expressly allows that interpretation to be performed and read by the operating surgeon. If the plan also requires the radiologist's report for the CT, I am requesting a copy from [imaging facility name] and will submit it; I ask the plan to confirm whether that single document is what it considered missing.

**9. The rheumatoid arthritis pathway**

The criteria referenced in connection with my denial include a separate section for rheumatoid arthritis:

> "II. Initial shoulder joint replacement may be considered medically necessary for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis when all the following criteria (A.-E.) are met: A. There is no active infection of the shoulder joint; and"

> "E. The patient has failed conservative treatment within the past year, including all of the following (1.-3.): 1. Disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs) for at least 12 weeks; and 2. At least 12 weeks of physical therapy, occupational therapy, or home exercise unless contraindicated (See Policy Guidelines); and 3. Activity modification for at least 12 weeks."

By its own terms, this section applies to treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, and its DMARD and 12-week requirements sit inside that section. My records do not describe rheumatoid arthritis. If my request was reviewed against Section II rather than against the osteoarthritis criteria, I ask the plan to say so in writing, because that would explain the finding of incomplete documentation and would be the wrong yardstick for my case.

## Request for the criteria the plan actually used

I am asking Providence Health Plan, in writing, for the exact clinical criteria used to deny this request — including the specific subsection or subsections of *Total Shoulder Arthroplasty MP430* that were applied, the name and edition of any review guideline relied on, and a plain statement of which particular document or finding was considered missing from my file. The plan holds these criteria; I do not. A denial for incomplete documentation cannot be answered until I know what the plan believes is absent. I am entitled to this information, and I ask that it be provided before or with the appeal decision.

## Closing

The records already submitted address the no-infection requirement, the pain and ADL requirement, the range-of-motion and crepitus requirement, the imaging findings, the conservative care documentation, the functional impairment documentation, and the 12-month imaging requirement, in the terms the plan's own policy uses. I respectfully ask that the denial dated 2026-08-02 be overturned and that CPT 23472 be authorized. If the plan maintains the denial, I ask for a written explanation that identifies the exact criterion not met and the document needed to meet it.

I understand this appeal must be received by **2027-01-29** (within 180 days of the 2026-08-02 notice). I am submitting it to the Appeals and Grievance Department, P.O. Box 4158, Portland, OR 97208-4158. I may also follow up on this appeal by telephone at **503-574-7500** or **800-878-4445**. I ask the plan to advise me in writing of any further review rights available to me and of the time limits that apply to them.

Please direct correspondence about this appeal to me at the address above.

**Enclosures:** [Physical therapy discharge note, 2026-06-06] · [Radiology report, shoulder radiographs 2026-05-21] · [CT report] · [Surgeon's clinic note, Dr. Duval, MD] · [Injection record, 2026-03-22] · [Copy of denial notice dated 2026-08-02]

---

Sincerely,

**Emerson Lawson**
Member ID: W445912797
Date of birth: [DOB]
Date: [Date]

Signature: ______________________________

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
